subject: general
question: Who among the following freedom fighter lawyers from Bengal is known as Deshbandhu?
solution:
The correct answer is **Chittaranjan Das**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chittaranjan Das**, also known as Deshbandhu, was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He played a vital role in the Non-Cooperation Movement against British rule.
 
• Das was also a leading lawyer of his times and the founder of the Swaraj Party in Bengal.
 
• His contributions to the freedom movement and his efforts to promote national education and social reform have made him a celebrated figure in Indian history.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 2) Durga Mohan Das
 Was a prominent social reformer and lawyer who worked for women's rights and education.
 
 

 3) Bipin Chandra Pal
 A freedom fighter, writer, and orator, Pal played a key role in the early phase of the Indian National Movement.
 
 

 4) Satish Ranjan Das
 A noted Indian barrister and the founder of the Doon School, Dehradun.
